reason: Selected after seven exploratory pilots: this setting improves raw CER/WER in both languages and has the lowest arithmetic mean of the two error rates (0.65). No text or ASR model is used in the optimizer.
success_check: At least 20 percentage points lower pooled Chinese CER and pooled English WER versus original v1, on all five recordings together, with correct-content gains and fresh-render repeat checks. Report per-recording results and regressions. This is a corpus-level ASR improvement, not proof of human intelligibility or new-voice generalization.
